setup_multilingual_lm_task: setup a multilingual language modeling task by loading dictionaries and configuring target types
load_multilingual_lm_dataset: load a multilingual language modeling dataset split with per-language resampling and smoothing
build_multilingual_lm_model: build a multilingual language model and validate that configured targets are supported
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for inference by prepending language tokens and appending pad tokens
run_multilingual_lm_inference: run inference on a multilingual language model with optional prefix tokens and language conditioning
